geoservices.note: GeoServices family only. SceneServer and I3S are the scene module. Import clients stay on every profile.

ogc-classic.note: Included only with ogc-api. ogc-api-classic is OGC API plus these classic services.

scene.note: SceneServer, I3S, and the scene dataset, generation, BIM, and point-cloud admin endpoints compile only with this module. Elevation HTTP in Honua.Server stays on every profile.

grpc.note: gRPC is not a separate project. MapGrpcService, UseGrpcWeb, reflection, and serving-status capture are compile-gated. HonuaFeatureService is omitted when GeoServices is excluded because it binds SpatialReferenceResolver. Grpc NuGet packages stay. HonuaProcessService stays in Honua.Geoprocessing.

mcp.note: MCP types live in Honua.Ai with NL query and studio AI. Endpoint mapping is compile-gated. The assembly stays. Default MCP admin projection must not block a restricted startup.

retainedShared.reason: Admin, styling, streaming, and the capability manifest use OGC common contracts. This is not the OGC API serving surface.
Processing stays on every profile. GeoServices GPServer mapping is gsr-only; OGC API processes mapping is ogc-api-only.
NL query, studio AI, and analysis stay. MCP routes are compile-gated inside this assembly.
Admin network topology, AI, and geoprocessing reference it. NAServer mapping is gsr-only.
Import client. Serving GeoServices exclusion does not remove import.
Admin geocoding stays. The GeoServices GeocodeServer adapter is gsr-only.

limitations: Geometry, objectId, and time filter translation for spatial analytics and GP layer selection binds the GeoServices query grammar and is omitted when geoservices is excluded. OGC profiles still execute geoprocessing.
Printing Tools GPServer and the GeocodeServer adapter are part of the gsr closure.
Esri catalog discovery returns no entries when geoservices is excluded. The store stays registered.
Data enrichment where-filters use the shared filter service when geoservices is excluded.
Import endpoints for GeoServices, OGC API Features, WFS, and coverages stay on every profile.
